objective: brain_next_engineering_action cannot say DONE for a Factory campaign that is live, nor NEEDS_HUMAN for one stopped on a person. server/mcp/engineeringTools.ts reachedForCampaign(state, prOpen) maps a campaign's stage to an outcome level: COMPLETE and AWAITING_RELEASE reach at most PR_OPEN, BLOCKED and CANCELLED reach null, and human_blocker_open is only ever the caller's value. So a session asking with intended_outcome PRODUCTION_WORKING about a campaign whose objective outcome (server/services/factory/release/outcome.ts objectiveOutcome) is LIVE is told to keep working, and one asking about a campaign that is BLOCKED on a person is never told NEEDS_HUMAN. Fix: when task_ref is a campaign id, derive `reached` and `humanBlockerOpen` from objectiveOutcome(campaign) — LIVE → PRODUCTION_WORKING; RELEASING with a release run in DEPLOYING or VERIFYING → MERGED (a merge sha exists); otherwise fall back to the existing stage mapping; outcome.needsPerson → humanBlockerOpen true (OR-ed with the caller's value). Keep reachedForCampaign for the fallback and keep every existing behaviour for non-campaign task refs.
expectedOutcome: brain_next_engineering_action answers DONE for a LIVE campaign asked about PRODUCTION_WORKING, and NEEDS_HUMAN for a campaign whose objective outcome needs a person.
nonGoals: Changing objectiveOutcome or any file under server/services/factory/
Any schema, route or migration change

acceptanceConditions.statement: tests/engineeringNextActionOutcome.test.ts: for a campaign whose objectiveOutcome is LIVE, the derived reached level is PRODUCTION_WORKING and the decision for intended_outcome PRODUCTION_WORKING is DONE.
For a campaign whose objectiveOutcome has needsPerson true, the decision is NEEDS_HUMAN even when the caller passes human_blocker_open false.
A campaign still building keeps the existing stage mapping (reachedForCampaign), and the repository typechecks.

rollbackRequirement: Revert the commit; no schema or data change.

release.reason: Benchmark: a small bounded change Factory should carry from submission to live with no person.
